summary.root_cause_text: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without recording payments, logged only at DEBUG.
recommended: Validate that the payments-v2 endpoint is reachable before retrying the migration
Alert on payment provider failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG

version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Revert the provider URL to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without recording payments, logged only at DEBUG.
evidence: recent_changes: config payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 by ops, 0 min ago
DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2 (27x)
alert: 12 of 26 orders processed without payment
args.impact: Orders were processed without payment while the bad URL was live (12 of 26 at alert time, 51 by reprocess time). All 51 were reprocessed and paid. money_recovered: SAR 9919.54, USD 4049.51, total_sar 25105.2.
recommended_actions: Validate that the payments-v2 endpoint is reachable before retrying the migration

args.summary: The ops config change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable. Orders were processed with no payment, and the failures appeared only in DEBUG logs. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders, and all invariants are now green."
